rows.text: [Trailblazer], you there?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: No, I am Pom-Pom
Yeah, you totally look like Pom-Pom. Alright, stop kidding around. There's something important
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I'm here. What's up?
I suddenly remember there was one thing that caught my attention during this trip to the Luofu
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: That Matrix of Prescience Ultima at the Divination Commission
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: The master diviner used that thing to interrogate Kafka, and saw right into her memories without Kafka even saying a word
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: So I was thinking... Could this matrix be used on me?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You didn't mention this earlier?
Why didn't you ask her at the Seat of Divine Foresight?
It's worth asking her...
It's worth asking. We might even be able to find your lost memories
Yes, yes! I wanted to ask at the Seat of Divine Foresight, but after thinking about it, I felt a little uneasy
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: The Luofu had just experienced a huge incident. Jing Yuan is injured, and the master diviner needs to manage the whole place
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I couldn't bring up this personal matter
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: So I thought I'd wait till she wasn't so busy, and then we could go to the Divination Commission together to ask her?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: No problem. Let's meet at the Divination Commission
I knew it! You're the best!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Do I have to go too?
Do I have to go too? It's not that I don't wanna, but this is your personal affair...
I... I... I'm just embarrassed to ask others for help on my own! See you at the Divination Commission
rows.speaker: March 7th
